integrity: The all-length conclusion is analytic. The bundled finite computation is only a regression check of the dephasing-sector identity and Choi algebra. The source paper and two closely related dephasing/state-transfer papers were compared by statement and implication. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes a vacuum-initialized number-conserving finite qubit chain and independent equal-rate Markovian pure dephasing. It does not cover relaxation, thermal or depolarizing noise, unequal dephasing rates, spatial correlations, non-Markovian noise, or arbitrary initial many-excitation states. Non-entanglement-breaking does not imply high transfer fidelity.
title: Finite local dephasing cannot entanglement-break perfect spin-chain transfer
